The gate nobody could satisfy

PR playground for #3971: why every src/hooks Dependabot PR was red, and the one field that fixes it.

plugins/ork/hooks/package.json is a tracked generated mirror of src/hooks/package.json, and it sits inside the build-drift roster (plugins/ minus only plugins/ork/hooks/dist). Dependabot edits the source manifest and, by design, never runs a build. So the mirror stayed at the old versions and the required Build check failed. Every time. The gate was correct. The automation could not satisfy it.

Why the two obvious fixes do not survive contact with the code

OptionWhat the repo already says
2. Extend the autoheal bot to Dependabot (the issue's pick) Already rejected, and enforced at the job if:. skill-autobuild.yml:59: Dependabot runs read GitHub's separate Dependabot secret store, so secrets.RELEASE_BOT_* resolve to empty and the token mint dies in about 4s, surfacing as a red autoheal check claiming a heal failed that never ran.
1. Drop the mirror from the drift roster Leaves it stale forever. release-please.yml:314's ALLOWED regex does not list this path, and the release rebuild commits only src/hooks/dist and plugins/ork/hooks/dist, so the release path never repairs it either.

The duplication was never load-bearing

The mirror has zero runtime dependencies. The plugin ships prebuilt dist/ plus bin/run-hook.mjs, and every entry under devDependencies (biome, typescript, vitest, esbuild, fast-check, @types/node) is build-time tooling that nothing installs from there. Deleting the field deletes exactly the version strings that drifted. 

+ STRIPPED=$(jq 'del(.devDependencies)' "$HOOKS_MANIFEST")

One line, directly below the package-lock.json exclude that the same rsync has carried for the same reason. Same reasoning, applied to one field instead of one file. Nothing is weakened: the gate still guards every shipped byte, including this file's remaining fields.

Proof, end to end

Bump every devDependency in the source manifest, rebuild, count the drift.

baseline plugins/ clean: YES
bumped ALL devDependencies in the source manifest
build rc=0
RESULT: plugins/ files changed by the bump = 0   (expect 0)
  -> #3971 class CLOSED
restored. tree clean: YES

The ratchet has three assertions, and the third is the one that matters

tests/plugins/test-hooks-manifest-mirror.sh. The first asserts no devDependencies. The second asserts the mirror still carries name/version/type/bin/engines, so a future "just exclude the whole file" cannot pass by deleting everything. The third is a positive control that bumps every devDependency and requires a byte-identical mirror. Without it the test would still pass if the strip were removed and someone hand-edited the mirror once, which is the failure mode that produced this issue. 

npm run build
bash tests/plugins/test-hooks-manifest-mirror.sh
Found alongside this, filed separately rather than fixed here: the same rsync also ships the test configs (vitest.bench.config.ts and friends) into the plugin, which is dev tooling users never run.
